title: Administration
subtitle: Practices, invitations and platform health.
noClinicalAccess: As platform administrator you manage practices and invitations, but you have no access to patients' clinical data: the database prevents it.
storageHelp: The Supabase Free plan includes 500 MB. If you get close to the limit, consider the Pro plan or shorten the retention of detailed recordings.
newOrgHelp: Create a practice and invite its owner: they will get an email to activate the account.
dpaReminder: Before any real data is entered, sign the data-processing agreement (GDPR art. 28) with the owner: see docs/gdpr.
manageHelp: Members, roles and invitations of this practice.
memberAdded: Existing account added to the practice
removeText: They will no longer access this practice's patients. Their account stays active.

invite.forbidden: You are not allowed to invite with this role.
invite.invite_failed: The invitation could not be sent. Try again later.
invite.org_create_failed: The practice could not be created.
invite.membership_failed: The person could not be added to the practice.

delivery.label: How to deliver the invitation
delivery.linkHelp: You get a one-time link (valid 24 hours) to send yourself, e.g. on WhatsApp or in person. No email service needs to be configured.
delivery.emailHelp: Sinapsi sends the email itself. In production this needs a configured SMTP service (see the deployment guide).

link.recoveryTitle: Link to choose a new password
link.help: Send this link only to {email}. It works once and is valid for 24 hours.
link.warning: Whoever has the link can choose this account's password: send it only to the person concerned, over an encrypted channel (WhatsApp, Signal) or in person. Their second factor will still be required to sign in.
link.inviteMessage: Hi! Here is the link to activate your Sinapsi account (valid 24 hours, single use): {link}
link.recoveryMessage: Here is the link to choose a new Sinapsi password (valid 24 hours, single use): {link}

resetMfaText: All of this person's authentication devices will be removed (e.g. if they lost their phone). They will set up a new one at the next sign-in. The action is recorded in the practice's activity log.
